title: HOI AN COMMUNITY RECREATION PARK
description: Hoi An City Park is envisioned as a vibrant urban green space where people, nature, and the community come together in a welcoming and sustainable environment. The project is designed to provide an inclusive destination
content:
Hoi An City Park is envisioned as a vibrant urban green space where people, nature, and the community come together in a welcoming and sustainable environment. The project is designed to provide an inclusive destination for all ages, especially families and children, where recreation, relaxation, and everyday activities are seamlessly connected with the surrounding natural landscape.

The design emphasizes open spaces, shaded walkways, playgrounds, landscaped gardens, and flexible gathering areas that encourage social interaction and outdoor activities. Native vegetation, water features, and environmentally conscious design strategies are integrated throughout the park to improve the local microclimate while creating a comfortable and enjoyable experience for visitors.

More than a recreational park, the project serves as a valuable public space that strengthens community connections, promotes healthy and active lifestyles, and enhances the urban identity of Hoi An. By balancing functionality, sustainability, and landscape aesthetics, the park becomes a vibrant destination where residents and visitors can connect with nature and create lasting memories.
